# SCTE TechExpo26: Aurora Networks Showcasing New Solutions to Give Operators Greater Flexibility in Network Modernization


Aurora Networks’ expanded portfolio paves the way for DOCSIS upgrades, the path to 50G PON and beyond


September 28, 2026


Richardson, TX


**Richardson, TX, September 28, 2026** – Aurora Networks, a business of


[Vistance Networks](https://www.vistancenetworks.com/)


(NASDAQ: VISN), today announced they are showcasing expanded DOCSIS® and PON portfolios at SCTE


TechExpo26 in Atlanta, GA, September 29 – October 1. The expanded DOCSIS portfolio is highlighting a Unified DOCSIS 4.0 Smart Amplifier, while the PON portfolio builds on its existing 50G lineup - introducing a variety of new 50G products, including 50G remote and shelf OLTs, and a 50G shelf ONU. Aurora Networks will also be demonstrating its AI management platform, transforming how service providers manage their entire network environment as they evolve into next-generation architectures.


Aurora Networks now offers the widest, most flexible 50G portfolio, with shelf OLTs for the headend, remote OLTs for the plant, ONUs for the subscriber, and intelligent vBNG / management software necessary for today’s multi-GB race.


“Aurora Networks helps operators modernize on their own terms; our platform-agnostic architectures and interoperable technologies enable operators to evolve with lower risk, greater flexibility and smarter modernization,” said Guy Sucharczuk, SVP & president, Aurora Networks. “With the latest additions to our portfolio, we also make it easier for customers who want more options as they upgrade to 50G, and to modernize operations with AI. We’re leading the industry, creating products that support any upgrade path our customers choose.”


The expanded PON Evo portfolio unveils a variety of solutions to meet operators’ needs including supporting:


·


ITU-T co-existence mode – supporting GPON, XGS-PON and 50G PON on the same fiber


·


10G EPON and 50G PON co-existence


·


DOCSIS provisioning and back-office for both ITU-T PON and IEEE PON (EPON)


·


Easier deployment with SDN activation, streaming telemetry, zero-touch provisioning


·


Deployment in Aurora Networks’ premier node housings and VHUBs


Aurora Networks is also showing a Unified DOCSIS 4.0 Smart Amplifier which combines support for both Full Duplex DOCSIS (FDX) and Frequency Division Duplex (FDD) / Extended Spectrum DOCSIS (ESD) out to 1.8 GHz in a single amplifier device with built-in cable modem. Along with the remote management capabilities supported by all our Smart Amplifiers, service providers can now deploy one common amplifier for any network architecture, while reducing management costs.


In addition to


unveiling these


new solutions


, the


global provider of intelligent network solutions will also


showcase


:


·


ServAssure® NXT AI – A catalog of cable and PON network surveillance and optimization solutions delivered in conjunction with our partner DvSum. As previously


[announced](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260922020972/en/DvSum-to-Showcase-the-Future-of-AI-Powered-Telecom-Operations-Alongside-Aurora-Networks-at-SCTE-TechExpo26) , our AI and automation solutions enable operations teams to analyze quickly and deliver triage to restore service faster.


·


IP Video and Advertising Solutions – The award-winning video portfolio provides solutions to efficiently streamline operations and lower total cost of ownership while also optimizing network operation. As part of a wider strategy of bandwidth optimization, migration to IP video can help reclaim portions of the RF spectrum to increase network capacities and speeds.


·


PKI and Security Solutions –


Aurora Networks’ solutions secure the cable industry’s manufacturing and software supply chains and has branched into mobile, semiconductors, and other areas that require connected device security. PKI services, secure code signing, and software assurance help operators protect valuable network assets, ensure compliance, and build subscriber trust in every connection.


·


Professional Services


–


Aurora Networks’ Professional Services team helps network operators design, deploy, expand and evolve their networks, and has been doing so for more than two decades. For service providers that require a complete HFC/FTTx solution, Aurora Networks offers a unique combination of services that will help providers achieve their goals.


Stop by booth #A107 to meet with our experts to discuss what solutions best meet your needs and to hear more about the expanded Aurora Networks’ portfolio. Visit our website at


[www.vistancenetworks.com](https://www.vistancenetworks.com/) .
